'''Cherush''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] around [[3638 BBY]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], Cherush was among the engineers the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] rescued from the Hutt Cartel. Along with fellow [[Beddek]] and [[Prahmin]], she was kidnapped by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and forced to assist in stabilizing Makeb's core.<ref name="TOR" />
